title: New advances in the treatment of chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps from pathophysiology to biologic targeted therapy.
snippet: Chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP) is a chronic airway disease characterized mainly by type 2 inflammation, which seriously impairs patients' quality of life and imposes a huge economic burden. title: Complete pathological response after neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy in PD-L1-negative unresectable primary hepatic small cell carcinoma: a case report and tumor microenvironment analysis.
snippet: Primary hepatic small cell carcinoma (PHSCC) is an extraordinarily rare and aggressive malignancy with a dismal prognosis. No standard treatment exists, and the role of immunotherapy in this tumor type, especially in programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) negative cases, remains unexplored.
